description:
At last, the origin of X-O Manowar revealed! How did Aric of Dacia become a slave to the Spider-Aliens? At what terrible cost was the X-O Manowar armor made? And how did Aric come to find himself in the modern day?

Released after X-O Manowar #18, a Gold variant cover exists

Death of Aric of Dacia's parents.

Aric of Dacia: Visigoth warrior, slave of the Spider-Aliens, wielder of the most powerful weapon in the universe. Armed with the X-O Manowar armor and trapped in the modern day, Aric will wage war on his one-time captors.

Escaping captivity aboard a Spider-Alien starship, Aric, the Visigoth, steals the aliens' greatest weapon: the Manowar Class X-O Armor! Returning to Earth, Aric is dismayed to find that 1600 years have passed -- it's a whole new world! Befriended by Ken Clarkson, Aric must learn to cope with a new society. But the aliens are hot on his trail, eager to reclaim the devastating armor known to Aric as the "Good Skin"!

1st appearance:

- X-O Manowar (Aric Dacia)

- Ken Clarkson

- Manowar class X-O Armor

- Lydia (Spider Alien)

The book opens in the middle of the action. We see Aric, a savage human fighting a bunch of spiderlike aliens ... naked. He makes his way to the armory where he finds a suit of armor. Passing it up at first as being to small to protect him.

In a moment of desperation and need, he grabs the Armors key ( a ring ) and puts it on. The armor surrounds him, and he easily dispatches his foes. He makes his escape from what we find out is a spaceship in Earths orbit.

When he lands he discards the armor and takes up residents at a near by village. At first he looks upon them with mistrust, but ends up living there and falling for a young woman. After some time away, he returns to find that the aliens had been there, and they killed everyone in the village.

Aric gets a message, that the aliens want the ring. They are in New York, and they want him to deliver it. Promising vengance, he uses the ring to find the armor.

His travels takes him through a south American town. There he is attacked by the spider aliens. After the battle, he meets Ken, a homosexual man, who takes an interest in the naked Aric. Ken brings Aric back to his house and cleans him up.

Joining Aric on his trip they take a plane to New York. When they get off the plane, Ken tries to warn Aric of an attack. Apparently, Ken was at first an agent for the aliens. Yet Arics friendship turned him. During the attack, Ken loses his left hand.

As the battle grows worse for Aric, he hears a voice in his hand, a voice that is seemingly calling to the Armor. At the last second, the X-O Armor arrives, and Aric is able to defeat his enemies. Knowing his armor will protect him, Aric Gathers his wounded friend hoping to save his life.

Prelude to the Wolfbridge Affair! Someone is breaking the most dangerous inmates out of Toyo Harada's correctional facility for mentally unstable Harbingers and he needs Aric's help to stop them!

From Wizard magazine, a Gold variant cover also exists.

Released after X-O Manowar 34.

Aric wakes from centuries of subterranean slumber to return to his corporate kingdom and the era he now calls home. And back in the modern day, Ken schemes to take the X-O armor for himself, while aliens lurk, but soon both will earn that here and now, Aric rules!

At Orb headquarters, Ken's artificial hand suddenly drags him out to a tree, under which Aric is hibernating. Ken takes home Aric, who, after 1600 years in hypersleep, is too weak to notice he's lost the Control Ring. Ken finds it, wanting the Armor for himself. But, realizing he's unworthy of the Armor, he returns to Aric just as a Spider Alien's cadre attacks the house. And Aric stands to fight, finding the Armor has evolved a new look!

issue_title: Seed Of Destruction - Part I: Alien Whisper
description:
Aric dons the good skin for the first time since his return from the past, only to find it changed. The armor's new form, together with sinister dreams of a golden seed and an alien arena, promise to reveal the true origin of the X-O armor!

Under attack by a squad of Spider Aliens, Aric uses his newly changed Armor to easily repulse the invaders. But he is uneasy about the sudden reappearance of his old enemies. Aric's thoughts are troubled in the days that follow, and his nightmarish dreams involve an alien ceremony for creation of the X-O Armor. At last, Aric awakens from one of the nightmares, only to find himself in the Armor, helplessly drawn toward to the Moon!

issue_title: Seed Of Destruction - Part II: Moonstruck
description:
From fitful dreams, Aric wakes to discover the good skin is taking him into the far reaches of space! There Rexo and the last of Aric's one-time captors lie in wait, desperate to claim the Manowar armor as their own!

Above the alien moonbase, Aric learns why he was brought here against his will. It seems the Armor has a Spore from which a Starship can be grown -- and the aliens want it! Aric enters the base and confronts Rexo, who claims the Good Skin's true name is Shanhara. When Rexo tries to take the Spore, Aric slays him and prepares to depart. But a squad of armored aliens snare him in energy-webs and drag him back to the base!

1st appearance:

- Randy Cartier

It's the finale to "The Seeds of Destruction" saga! Aric and Maka will fight to the death-- on the moon! But without the aid of the X-O armor, what chance does Aric have against a killer with blood colder than space? One will fall and one will claim the prize: the seed of Shanhara!

Within the moonbase, Aric goes toe-to-toe with the hulking Spider Champion! The alien anticipates an easy victory, only to find that, even without the Armor, Aric still has the strength to snap his neck! When Solar is unable to find out the Spider Homeworld's location, only one option remains: obliteraiton of the alien moonbase. So, reclaiming the Armor, Aric leaves Solar, who first destroys the base, then vaporizes the Spore!

issue_title: The Coming Of Turok Dinosaur Hunter
description:
Aric returns his space to find danger on the home front?Orb Industries scientists are breeding dinosaurs! When Aric learns that the tissue samples they've cloned are only weeks, and not millions of years, old, he'll set out on a hunt for the time-lost monsters that must be leaving them behind. But he'll need help if he wants to track down these cretaceous killers!

Cast from the Lost Land at the end of Unity, Turok finds that his enemies, the bionisaurs, have also arrived in this modern age! When Aric is drawn to signals from bionisaur cyber-implants, he arrives in Colombia to meet the Dinosaur Hunter. The two men, both warriors cast out of their times, form a bond of mutual respect. And, when they violently shut down a bionisaur-part black market, Aric knows he has found a brother-in-arms!

Prehistory and present day collide as hyper-intelligent dinosaurs ransack Manhattan! With mankind suddenly at the bottom of the food chain, Aric will need to enlist some help to win this fight. But will the combined might of X-O Manowar and his new allies be enough to save New York from these cannibalistic sauroid underground dwellers?

Corporate espionage strikes at Orb Industries! When an Orb employee is mysteriously killed on the coast of New England, Aric uncovers a sinister secret. Someone is selling Spider-Alien tech to the black market and Aric will need Ken's help to track down this inside trader!

X-O Manowar doesn't scare easily?especially when the New York mob tries to muscle in on Orb Industries. But these feeble hustlers will soon find out Aric is one CEO you don't want to mess with! But these corporate struggles will leave him wondering if he'll ever really be at home in the modern world.

The CIA wants the X-O Manowar armor, but Aric won't hand it over! How long can Aric refuse the government's demands without endangering those closest to him? The fight of Aric's life begins here, sending him on a quest to the most brutal ends of the Earth!

issue_title: Operation: Deep Freeze - Part 2: Gentlemen's Agreement
description:
To save Randy's life, Aric must surrender the X-O armor! Trapped in a prison deep within Antarctica, Aric and Randy will have to escape before the good skin turns bad. But even if they can break free, there's no avoiding the deadly polar deep freeze!

1st appearance:

- Dr. Philip Zahn

- Armorines

With his friend and ally, Ken Clarkson, Aric brings his war on the Spider Aliens to the heart of their empire on Earth -- the corporate headquarters of Orb Industries. But Lydia and Spider Aliens have set a trap there for their most savage of foes.

Even as Aric and Ken strive to consolidate their new corporate empire, Toyo Harada dispatches the bionic assassin, Sniper, to slay the armored alien seen recently in New York. When Sniper confronts Aric, Harada realizes that this armored warrior is no alien when he shows concern for the injured bystanders! Ordering Sniper to withdraw, Harada ponders how to deal with this powerful new entity.

1st appearance:

- X-O Armor Wolf Class

The issue opens with X-o fighting a spider alien. Afterwards he carries his friend to his home where his doctor roommate stops him from bleeding to death from his severed arm. As they are resting, the house is attacked and Arics friend Eddie ia kidnapped.

He follows his armor to the alien headquarters their he meets and kills what he believes to be the king of the aliens. Only it ends up being a trap set by the queen, yet when she shows her teeth to him, Aric quickly disposes of her.

Ken comes to him after that and realizes that they have just won the war against the aliens.

issue_title: Operation: Deep Freeze - Part 3: The Consequences
description:
No one is safe in this sense-shattering conclusion to "Operation Deep Freeze!" They stole his armor and endangered his loved ones. Now, the CIA must pay for their sins?and the ramifications will reach as far as the Oval Office! But when the dust and blood settles, will X-O Manowar truly find peace?

Randy Cartier puts on the X-O ring for the first time...

The beginning of an all-new direction for X-O Manowar! Faced with a crisis of conscience, Aric bequeaths the X-O armor to Randy Cartier! Can Randy answer the hero's call or will this sudden surge of power overwhelm her?

issue_title: White Kings And Black Knights - Part 1
description:
As Randy discovers the secrets of Shanahara, Aric travels abroad for some much-needed soul searching! Yet Aric will realize that evil has no borders, sending him on a deadly adventure that may also be his last!

Randy Cartier in X-O Armor.

issue_title: White Kings And Black Knights - Part 2
description:
Aric's escape from civilization takes a surprising turn for the worse! With his adopted village as the target of a much larger conspiracy, Aric must once again rise as a protector of the innocent. But without the X-O Manowar armor's protection, can Aric ever be the hero he once was? It's metal vs. mettle as Aric's true strength is finally tested!

Randy Cartier in X-O Armor.

Aric returns! As the startling events of last issue force Aric home, Randy reaches a breaking point with the X-O Manowar armor. When the two bearers of Shanahara finally cross paths, what life-altering decisions will each warrior make? The seeds to the future are planted, sending X-O Manowar, and a mysterious new player, on a one-way collision course!

Gear up for war, as the Armorines make their explosive debut to the Valiant Universe! X-O Manowar is in for a rude awakening when he realizes he isn't the only armored agent in town. With a target on his back, can Aric outlast not one, but dozens of similarly powered soldiers?

Contains Armorines #0.

X-O Manowar makes his first foray in corporate warfare! As the holiday season settles over New York, Aric stumbles into a secret liason at the Orb Industries Chistmas party that will prove that not all gifts are things to be thankful for. And which item is at the top of everyone's most wanted list? The X-O Manowar armor!

Aric traces a mysterious trail of green blood, only to walk right into a surprise attack by extraterrestrials! But, while battling the alien colony, the X-O armor begins to starngely malfunction. Who or what could be causing this?

With the X-O armor still mysteriously weakening Aric finds himself in a desperate battle to defend his home and his friends against an alien onslaught. With Shanhara weakened and his home compromise, Aric learns that his enemies fight no longer to save Shanhara, but to destroy her!

Shanhara is dead! With the X-O armor destroyed, Aric finds himself in his most desperate fight yet! Will he be able to fend off his aliens attackers without the armor, or will his friends pay the price? And without the armor, will Aric still have a place in the modern world?

issue_title: The Most Powerful Man In The World!
description:
With the power of the X-O Manowar armor to aid them, Ken and Aric take control of Orb Industries. Now, threatened by the growing power of the Spider Aliens, Toyo Harada, CEO and Founder of the Harbinger Foundation sends an assassin after Aric.

Pursued by Spider Alien forces, Aric must protect his injured friend, Ken, who has lost a hand to alien laser-fire. But, in the battle, Ken is abducted by Aric's foes! Aric follows Ken's trail to the alien-owned Orb Industries office in New York. There, Lydia, a genetically-enhanced Spider Alien, tried to seduce Aric and take, by guile, what no power can wrest from him. But Aric beats her trap and seizes Orb as his spoils-of-war!

In this issue, Aric and his friend Ken settle into their new role as heads of Orb industries. Toyo Harada, not knowing Aric is now in charge of Orb industries, sends an assassin over to kill the people in charge. Only to want to call his dog off when he sees Aric do something noble. Knowing Aric is not an alien, he makes it his plan to find out who he is.

Aric struggles to come to term with the loss of the X-O Manowar armor. But he'll find hope when an ally journeys to the depths of the Solar System and discovers a latent seed taht could regrow the Manowar armor. But the seed will not germinate without a blood sacrifice. Will Aric or one of his friends pay the ultimate price so that X-O Manowar can live again?

Paul's sacrifice to restore the X-O armor has driven a wedge between Aric and Randy. She leaves for Paul's memorial and Aric acquaints himself with his new armor, but something is not quite the same with this new Good Skin. But Aric will still have to put his it to the test against a whole new enemy when he's called to account for the death of one his employees at Orb Industries.

Who is Krollos? And why has he infilitrated Orb Industries? Aric will have to survive the onslaught of this deadly new foe and his mysterious technology if he hopes to find out! Meanwhile, the past comes back to haunt Randy when death stalks her old comrades-in-arms--the Wolfbridge Goup--at the memorial service of the fallen Paul Bouvier.

issue_title: The Gathering - Part III: Old Acquaintances
description:
Toyo Harada has provided Aric with the location of an alien gathering, and Aric means to make the most of it! Meanwhile, Earth is in the grips of a worldwide disaster and the assassin Snakebite is on the hunt for Randy Cartier! Guest starring the Armorines and H.A.R.D. Corps!

Chaos Effect Delta

Continued from Armorines #5,

to be continued in H.A.R.D. Corps #23.

issue_title: The Vengeance Trail - Part I: Quest
description: Aric has returned to South America to track down the killers of a native tribe, but he's about to be reunited with the Skammrs and facing their familiar sauroid foe! And can Randy keep herself and her friends alive when the venomous assassin Snakebite comes calling?

issue_title: The Vengeance Trail - Part II: Deceitful Players
description: Aric tries to negotiate with the Skammrs' new leader for information about the death of a native South American tribe. But when the coming of X-O Manowar proves both a threat and an opportunity, Agannon seizes the chance to strike!

issue_title: The Vengeance Trail - Part 3: Chasing Dreams
description:
Aric is unarmed and face-to-face with an angry dinosaur! Can he stay alive long enough for Ken to work his wiles and return control of the X-O armor to him? Meanwhile, Randy and the Wolfbridge group corner the deadly assassin named Snakebite and find out once and for all who it is that wants them all dead!

Valiant Sneak Peek bonus card originally included.

When an assassin breaks three psychotic harbingers out of a Harada correctional facility, Aric resolves to recapture them. But he'll find himself at a considerable disadvantage when the mind of Paul Bouvier tries to take over the X-O armor!

issue_title: The Wolfbridge Affair Part 2 of 4: Pawns
description: Poisoned by Snakebite and on the verge of death, Aric's only hope is Randy Cartier! Will she be able to get the X-O armor back online in time?

Aric and Randy face off against a trio of renegade harbingers. If they can survive, they'll have Helena Wolfbridge and her twin polaris missiles to deal with. But they'll have some help from an old ally from Blighty to see them through.

Toyo Harada wants to make a deal with the new head of Orb Industries, but nobody told him to expect X-O Manowar! Featuring Peter Stanchek, the Harbinger renegades and the first appearance of Shadowman.

Agreeing to meet with Toyo Harada, Aric and Ken travel to New Orleans. Learning of this rendezvous, the Harbinger kids also go to New Orleans, hoping to kill their nemesis, Harada! As Aric and Harada toast their mutual respect, the Harbingers suddenly attack. Donning his armor, the drunken Aric is too much for the kids to handle, and they swiftly retreat. Harada thanks Aric, even as he plans to use the barbarian as his pawn.

1st appearance:

- Jack Boniface (Shadowman)

In this issue Ken brings information to Aric about last issues would be assassin. They discover Haradas link to the killer just in time to recieve an invitation to Haradas offices in New Orleans. When they arrive apologies are made and proper respect is given to and by both Harada and Aric.

Afterwards they go out on the town. It is Mardi Gras, and Harada wants to show them the sights. While they are out, The kids from the Harbinger project attacks them thinking Aric is with Harada.

Can even the X-O Manowar armor survive a hit from a Polaris missile? Randy and Ninjak better hope so, otherwise they'll stand no chance of surviving terrorist Helena Wolfbridge and her psychotic trio of harbinger lackeys.

After taking a direct hit from a Polaris missile strike in the Wolfbridge affair, something isn't right with Aric. Now, lost and fever maddened, Aric will need Ninjak and Randy Cartier to work together to save him from a murderous mob of Berlin Neo-Nazis.

Orb Industry holdings in New Orleans are under attack and Aric is called to investigate. But in New Orleans the night belongs to the Shadowman, and things are sure to get dangerous in the Big Easy when Shadowman villains Ishmael and Blister set these two heroes against each other!

This issue contains a special comic inside with its own cover and indicia: "X-O Manowar: Birthquake Prequel".

Ken Clarkson is throwing a formal Orb Industries party and everyone's invited. But while things get awkward when Aric and recently parted love interest Randy Cartier both show up with dates on their arms, they're going to get downright lethal when Sister Serenity and her ecclesiastical mercenaries crash the party!

Aric wakes in the year 410 A.D., a prisoner of the Roman Empire and with his wife alive by his side. Convinced that his years in space with the Spider Aliens, his life in the future and the X-O Manowar armor were all delusions, Aric swears to free himself from bondage or to die trying! But this prison is not what it appears to be...

The year is 410 A.D. and Aric must free his people from Roman bondage! But when flashes of a different life in a different time start to intrude, Aric starts to realize this world of the past is not all it seems. But will he come to his senses soon enough to save himself from the clutches of Mistress Crescendo?

Freed from the delusion of a life with his wife and his people in the distant past, Aric swears revenge against his mysterious captor, the lovely and deadly Mistress Crescendo. But he'll soon find he's already lost far more to her than to any foe he's ever faced before!

Mistress Crescendo has taken over Orb Industries! Will Aric be able to defeat her illusions and learn the secrets of this most dangerous of enemies? One way or the other, by the time the dust settles, one of Aric's friends will have paid the ultimate price!
Aric violently despairs over the loss of his friends and Orb Industries. But even the comforting words of one of his few remaining friends may not be enough to pull him out of his rage!

After destroying his home and cutting ties with his old life, Aric decides to return to the place of Shanhara's death. But something strange is happening as the consciousness of Paul Bouvier begins to take control of the X-O Armor!

Ken solidifies his control over Orb Industries and struggles to make Aric understand that over a thousand years have passed since he was abducted. Then, a criminal Harbinger named Ax, with the power to control machines, comes looking for a new toy to play with -- the X-O Manowar armor!

Impatient with the complexities of the modern world, Aric wants little to do with running Ord Industries. Ken, on the other hand, loves his new wealth and power, and plots to kill Aric, taking the Armor for himself. But Ken lacks the nerve and is terrified when Aric realizes is treachery! Aric leaves, sparing Ken, only to have both Ken and the Armor snatched by Ax. But, Ax is about to learn just how harshly Aric deals with bandits!

Aric has severed the consciousness of Paul Bouvier from the X-O armor and, for the very first time, made it entirely his own. But, when Paul takes control of the shattered remnants of Shanhara, Aric's original armor, he'll have to face his enemy in his new form as Alloy!

Paul, now Alloy, continues his attack on Aric.

Aric must fight the consciousness of Paul Bouvier for control of the X-O armor armed with nothing but his wits, a sword, and the absolute will to win! But will that be enough to defeat the full might of the universe's most powerful weapon?
Aric faces his demons both figuratively and literally! Will he be able to overcome the past and a horrifying monster that blames Aric for what he has become?!
An enemy vowing revenge on Aric attacks mercilessly! Will Aric be able to defeat this formidable foe? And will his dark secrets be revealed?

Wandering through deep space, Aric finds a Spider Alien spacecraft lost and adrift. The few remaining survivors of the damaged craft pose little threat to the X-O Manowar armor, but what about the strange and unknown alien race that is hunting them?

In the clutches of Krytos! Aric must endure torture as the alien general's forces attempt to strip him of the X-O armor. Can he escape from their clutches and win the fight against this strange new enemy?
A duel for the X-O Manowar armor with the champion of Krytos! To the winner, an empire; to the loser, death! Can Aric survive his alien opponent's savage might?

The showdown with the machine-controlling villain Ax continues, but with his control of the X-O Manowar armor scrambled can Aric still prevail? Aric will show Ax what he does to bandits and Ken what he does to traitors!

As Aric attacks Ax's cyborgs, Ax dons his own alien battle-armor. The ensuing fight leads from air to sea, to an island where Ax's scrambler paralyzes Aric's armor. But he sheds the Good Skin and still bests Ax! Aric spares Ax's life, exchanging him for Ken. But Ken still cannot be trusted, so Aric replaces Ken's severed hand with an extension of an armor that will slay Ken should he ever betray Aric again!

Aric, his fortune lost, finds companions among the poor and huddles masses of New York City. But when a wealthy art dealer decides to paint his masterpiece with the blood of the city's homeless, he'll find himself face to face with the wrath of the X-O Manowar!

Face with an enemy hidden behind an impregnable wall of money and respectability, Aric contemplates new tactics. But even on this modern day battlefield Aric's enemies will be hard pressed to beat the power of the X-O Manowar armor!

Aric faces the deadliest menace in the Valiant universe, the malignant necromancer Master Darque! And he wants the most powerful weapon in the universe for himself! Will Aric prevail, or will Master Darque win the power of the X-O Manowar armor!
Master Darque has taken control of the X-O armor! Can an unarmored Aric stands against Darque's necromantic power and reclaim the armor that is rightfully his?
Aric has reclaimed the X-O armor, but has even a brief time under the control of Master Darque corrupted it beyond hope of recovery? Will he remain simply Aric... or will X-O Manowar fight again?

In a lethal fight with the machine-controlling villain, Ax, Aric learns that his control over the X-O armor is slipping. Fearing it is the lingering influence of Master Darque, Aric turns to Dr. Mirage to help cleanse the armor of the necromancer's taint.

Unable to control the armor any longer, Aric finds himself lost, his world slipping away. Is this truly the final fate of the armored Visigoth, or is there something more sinister at play that is making him relive his early days as X-O Manowar in strange and vivid dreams?
Aric has been set adrift in time to confront again the awesome force of Mothergod! Or has he? The ultimate secrets of the legend of Aric of Dacia revaled in this explosive final issue!

issue_title: Unity Chapter 5: A Call To Arms
description:
The Geomancer warns of a grave threat to all of existence! Aric and the Harbinger renegades team up to fight temporal slavers and an army from beyond time and space!

Unity Chapter FIVE

Unable to destroy his artificial hand, Ken begs Aric to remove it. Aric assures Ken that he may someday earn its removal, then goes to settle an Orb labor dispute by his barbaric honor code. When Geoff comes seeking help in the Unity Conflict, Aric eagerly answers the call of battle. Later, in the Lost Land, Aric's effective leadership skills enable him to build an army from the savage Skammr tribe and create himself a new empire!

Aric's will to live is tested to its absolute limit as he leads his army of time-tossed barbarians to war against a trans-temporal empire!

Unity Chapter THIRTEEN

Having become an independent force in the Lost Land, Aric is now at odds with the other heroes! Wishing to ransom a stolen part of Mothergod's Unity Reactor, Aric is opposed by Rai, who wants it destroyed! At last, Aric's reason wins out and he destroys the component. Angered, Mothergod has her bionisaurs ambush Aric's camp. Aric is nearly bitten in half before the Good Skin saves him, but his Skammrs are killed and his empire broken!

Aric is returned to his own time and, with the power of the X-O armor at his command, he's determined to lay waste to the Roman Empire once and for all! But have his adventures in time and space changed him too much for his family, his love and his people to welcome this man returned with the power of a god?

Transported from the Lost Land by Solar's power, Aric finds himself back in his true home: Rome, 408 A.D.! Aric hurries to the camp of his uncle, Alaric, eager to rejoin his loved ones. But this man of god-like power isn't the Aric they remember! So great is their fear, that the Visigoths scheme with the hated Romans to kill Aric. The plot fails, but Aric knows this is no longer his home, and he buries himself in the armor, craving only oblivion.
